attributes.title: 2027 New England School Nurse Conference: Anchored in Hope
attributes.cme_provider: University of Vermont Larner College of Medicine Continuing Education
attributes.summary:
The 2027 New England School Nurse Conference, "Anchored in Hope: Charting a Course for Healthier Schools," runs from Friday evening, April 30, to midday Sunday, May 2, 2027, at the Newport Marriott Hotel & Spa in Rhode Island. The event rotates among the school nurse associations of Connecticut, Maine, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, Rhode Island and Vermont.

The organizers list 9.0 CE credits, with continuing education from the University of Vermont Larner College of Medicine. Registration is open with an early-bird rate; regular registration ends December 31, 2026. Fee amounts are not shown on the event page. The host hotel block is $319 a night, with an overflow block at the Wyndham Newport.
